title: Namaz for fulfillment of needs (4)
introduction:
PRAYER OF SURAH AL-AN’AM FOR GRANTED REQUESTS

A four-unit prayer for having prayers answered by the blessing of Surah al-An’am.

verses.translation: Offer a four-unit prayer, reciting Surah al-Faatehah and Surah al-An’am in each unit. Upon accomplishment, say the following supplication:

verses.arabic: يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ
verses.translation: O All-generous! O All-generous! O All-generous!

verses.arabic: يَا عَظِيْمُ يَا عَظِيْمُ يَا عَظِيْمُ
verses.translation: O All-great! O Allgreat! O All-great!
O Greater than all great ones!
O Unaffected by nights and days!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household
and have mercy on my feebleness, neediness,
because You know them better than I do
and You know my need better than I do.
O He Who had mercy upon Jacob, the old man,

verses.arabic: حِيْنَ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ يُوْسُفَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنِهِ
verses.translation: when He returned Joseph, the delight of his eyes, to him!

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ رَحِمَ اَيُّوْبَ بَعْدَ طُوْلِ بَلَاۤئِهِ
verses.translation: O He Who had mercy upon Job after a long time of tribulation!
O He Who had mercy upon Muhammad,
Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him,

verses.arabic: وَ نَصَرَهُ عَلٰى جَبَابِرَةِ قُرَيْشٍ وَ طَوَاغِيْتِهَا
verses.translation: Who gave shelter to him against orphanhood,
Who gave him victory against the tyrants and despots of Quraysh

verses.arabic: يَا مُغِيْثُ يَا مُغِيْثُ يَا مُغِيْثُ۔
verses.translation: and Who gave him control over them!
